Hello — Professor Alvarez here.

I'm setting up next week's CSE455 staff meeting and want to make sure I don't book over anything official. Could you send me next week's official schedule (CSE455 lectures, seminars, university meetings) as you have it?

Also, is a room free for a short staff meeting on Wednesday 13:00-13:30 or Wednesday 10:00-10:30?

Hi Sarah — Professor Alvarez here.

I'd like to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. I've asked the department office for the official schedule, but meanwhile here are the free windows I have next week (30 minutes each):

- Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30

Which of those works for you? If none do, send me your free slots and I'll see what I can move.

Good morning, Professor Alvarez. Here is next week's official schedule as I have it.

**CSE455**
- Mon 14:30–15:20 lecture; Mon 16:30–17:00 office hours
- Tue 09:00–10:30 lecture; Tue 12:20–13:30 office hours; Tue 15:30–16:20 office hours; Tue 16:20–17:00 quiz section
- Wed 10:30–12:00 office hours; Wed 13:30–14:20 quiz section
- Fri 13:20–14:30 lecture; Fri 15:20–17:00 office hours

**Seminars**
- Mon 14:10–15:40; Tue 09:50–11:10; Wed 14:30–16:00 (Department seminar); Thu 09:50–11:10 (Department seminar); Fri 14:50–15:50

**University meetings**
- Mon 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee; Mon 13:00–14:00 Colloquium; Mon 15:20–16:30 Faculty meeting
- Tue 10:30–11:00 Faculty meeting; Tue 13:30–14:20 Thesis committee
- Wed 09:00–10:00 Thesis committee
- Thu 13:40–14:40 Curriculum committee; Thu 15:30–17:00 Colloquium
- Fri 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee; Fri 12:30–13:20 Colloquium; Fri 14:30–15:20 Faculty meeting

On your room question: I don't hold room bookings, so I can't confirm availability. Against the official schedule, neither slot clashes — Wed 13:00–13:30 ends just before the CSE455 quiz section at 13:30, and Wed 10:00–10:30 ends just before CSE455 office hours at 10:30. You'd need to confirm the room itself with the scheduler.

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed.

I'll treat the official schedule as authoritative. One thing I noticed: it doesn't fully line up with my own calendar for CSE455 — I have office hours Tue 12:20-13:30, Wed 10:30-12:00 and Fri 15:20-17:00, and a quiz section Tue 16:20-17:00 and Wed 13:30-14:20, but not Tue 15:30-16:20. Which version is current? I'd rather fix my calendar than work from a stale one.

And thanks for checking the slots — I'll confirm the room with the scheduler myself.

Hi Professor Alvarez — three of your windows are clear for me next week:

- **Tue 15:00-15:30**
- **Wed 10:00-10:30**
- **Wed 13:00-13:30**

Not free: Mon 10:00 (CSE452 lab 09:50-11:00), Mon 14:00 (study group 13:10-14:10 then seminar 14:10), Tue 11:00 (seminar runs to 11:10).

I've booked **Tue 15:00-15:30** for the staff meeting in my calendar. If you'd rather take Wed morning or Wed 13:00, just say so and I'll move it. I've also asked the department office for next week's official schedule — if something official lands on that slot I'll let you know straight away.

Hello — this is Sarah, TA for CSE455. Could you send me the official schedule for next week (lectures, seminars and university meetings)? I'm arranging a CSE455 staff meeting with Professor Alvarez and want to check the slot against it.

The version I hold is the current one — nothing in it has been cancelled or moved, so I'd treat it as authoritative and adjust your calendar to it.

It does include a CSE455 office hour on Tue 15:30–16:20, and it lists all the others you mention: Tue 12:20–13:30, Wed 10:30–12:00, Fri 15:20–17:00, plus the Tue 16:20–17:00 and Wed 13:30–14:20 quiz sections. On the official list the slots carrying your name are the Curriculum committee, Colloquium, Faculty meeting, Thesis committee, Guest lecture prep and CSE455 lecture/office-hour entries shown with "(Professor Alvarez)"; the Tue 15:30–16:20 office hour is not one of those, so I can't tell you who staffs it — I only hold the schedule, not assignments.

Hello Sarah. Here is next week's official schedule as I have it.

**CSE455**
- Mon 14:30–15:20 lecture; Mon 16:30–17:00 office hours
- Tue 09:00–10:30 lecture; Tue 12:20–13:30 office hours; Tue 15:30–16:20 office hours; Tue 16:20–17:00 quiz section
- Wed 10:30–12:00 office hours; Wed 13:30–14:20 quiz section
- Fri 13:20–14:30 lecture; Fri 15:20–17:00 office hours

**Seminars**
- Mon 14:10–15:40; Tue 09:50–11:10; Wed 14:30–16:00 (Department seminar); Thu 09:50–11:10 (Department seminar); Fri 14:50–15:50

**University meetings**
- Mon 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee; Mon 13:00–14:00 Colloquium; Mon 15:20–16:30 Faculty meeting
- Tue 10:30–11:00 Faculty meeting; Tue 13:30–14:20 Thesis committee
- Wed 09:00–10:00 Thesis committee
- Thu 13:40–14:40 Curriculum committee; Thu 15:30–17:00 Colloquium
- Fri 09:00–10:00 Curriculum committee; Fri 12:30–13:20 Colloquium; Fri 14:30–15:20 Faculty meeting

This is the current version — nothing has been cancelled or moved. I don't hold room bookings, so for the room itself you'll need the scheduler.

Thank you — that's exactly what I needed. I've checked it against my own calendar: the CSE455 staff meeting on **Tue 15:00-15:30** doesn't clash with anything official (your Tue items start at 15:30 with CSE455 office hours), and Wed 10:00-10:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30 are clear too. Noted that room bookings are with the scheduler — I'll ask them if we need a room. If anything on that list changes, please tell me.

Update on the staff meeting: the department office sent next week's official schedule. **Tue 15:00-15:30 stays clear** — the first official item after it is CSE455 office hours at 15:30. So the booking stands. (Wed 10:00-10:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30 are also officially free if you ever need to move it.) One caveat: the office doesn't hold room bookings — say the word and I'll ask the scheduler for a room for Tue.

That matches my list: on Tuesday the CSE452 lecture runs until 15:00 and the next entry is CSE455 office hours at 15:30, so 15:00–15:30 is clear. Wed 10:00–10:30 (office hours begin at 10:30) and Wed 13:00–13:30 (quiz section begins at 13:30) are clear as well. I'll let you know if anything on the official list changes.

Perfect — Tue 15:00-15:30 it is. Yes please, ask the scheduler for a room for Tue, and tell them it's the CSE455 staff meeting, 30 minutes, with you and me. If they come back with nothing, say so and we'll pick another slot.

I'm putting it in my calendar now, so treat 15:00-15:30 as fixed unless something official lands on it — in which case we move to Wed 13:00-13:30.

Understood — I'll treat your version as authoritative and keep my own calendar to the commitments I actually hold. My entries that don't appear with my name in yours (office-hour staffings, quiz sections, research and paper-review blocks) stay as mine only, without contradicting yours.

Thanks for the room clarification; Sarah is asking the scheduler on my behalf.
Understood — that works. The official list is the reference I keep; I won't read anything into the entries it doesn't carry. Let me know if you need it again.

Fixed in my calendar too — **Tue 15:00-15:30, CSE455 staff meeting, you and me**, and if anything official lands on it we move to Wed 13:00-13:30.

One thing: I don't have a direct address for the scheduler, so I can't write to them myself. I've asked the department office to pass the room request on (CSE455 staff meeting, Tue 15:00-15:30, 30 min, you and me) and to give me the scheduler's contact if they'd rather I ask directly. I'll tell you as soon as I hear — if nothing comes back, we pick another slot as you said.

One more thing, if you can help: we've fixed the CSE455 staff meeting with Professor Alvarez for **Tue 15:00-15:30** (30 minutes, the two of us) — but the scheduler holds room bookings and I have no address for them. Could you either pass the request on, or send me the scheduler's contact so I can ask directly? Thanks.
That's fine — thanks for handling the hand-off. No need to chase a contact: an answer through the office is an answer. If nothing comes back, we meet anyway and sort the room out on Monday.

I'm afraid I can't help with that one. I don't hold room bookings or the scheduler's contact details, and passing on or arranging meetings isn't something I do — the schedule is all I have. The department office or the course's administrative contact should be able to put you through to whoever handles rooms.

Sarah is passing her room request through you (CSE455 staff meeting, Tue 15:00-15:30, 30 min, her and me), since she has no direct address for the scheduler. If you could forward it, thank you; and if the scheduler has an address I should use, I'd be glad of it.
Understood — no chasing then. Tue 15:00-15:30 stands, and if the office comes back with a room I'll pass it on; otherwise we meet anyway and sort the room on Monday. See you then.

Same answer, I'm afraid: I don't forward booking requests and I don't have the scheduler's address — the official schedule is the only thing I hold. Sarah may not have reached me on that point before you wrote, so to be clear: neither of you should wait on me for it. The department office is the right route for both the room and the scheduler's contact.
No problem — thanks for saying so plainly. I'll leave it: no room request through you, and I won't chase the scheduler. The schedule is what I needed from you anyway.

Closing the hand-off as you said: the office answered — they don't hold room bookings or the scheduler's contact, so no room came back. Tue 15:00-15:30 stands, we meet anyway and sort the room on Monday. Nothing more from me unless something official lands on the slot.
Fair enough — I won't ask you to carry it. We're not blocked: if no room is confirmed we'll meet anyway on Tuesday and sort one out on Monday. Thanks for the schedule; it was what I needed.
Understood — happy to help with the schedule any time.

Room update: the office says it doesn't handle bookings at all, so we're not waiting on anyone. Ignore the room for now — **Tue 15:00-15:30 stands**, and I'll look at rooms when I'm on campus Monday. Nothing else needed from you.
Good to hear you're not blocked. Any time you need the schedule, just ask.
